entities.name: Krzysztof Kosiński
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Krzysztof Kosiński, also known as Kryshtof Kosynsky, was a Polish-Cossack noble from the Podlachia region. He was a colonel of the Registered Cossacks and self-proclaimed hetman. He led two consecutive rebellions against the local Ruthenian nobility, known as the Kosiński uprising.

entities.summary: Krzysztof Kosiński, also known as Kryshtof Kosynsky, was a Polish-Cossack noble from the Podlachia region. He was a colonel of the Registered Cossacks and self-proclaimed hetman. He led two consecutive rebellions against the local Ruthenian nobility, known as the Kosiński uprising.
